## Focused Technical Specs (Token-Saving)
- [docs/ai/01-dsp-and-spice.md](docs/ai/01-dsp-and-spice.md): DSP blocks, `ToneProcessor`, `SignalChainEngine`, `WhiteBoxAmpEngine`, `RealtimeSpiceCircuit`, `RigBenchmarkSuite`.
- [docs/ai/02-audio-and-bridge.md](docs/ai/02-audio-and-bridge.md): `AudioRouter` ASIO/WASAPI routing, `RigWebBridge` IPC actions & events, React `web-ui/` layout.
- [docs/ai/03-mcp-and-npx.md](docs/ai/03-mcp-and-npx.md): `tools/NeuralRigMcp` C# server, `packages/neuralrig-mcp` npm CLI/stdio bridge across 7 AI clients.
- [docs/ai/04-cloud-ota-admin.md](docs/ai/04-cloud-ota-admin.md): `cloud/` Next.js API routes, `001_neuralrig_cloud.sql` RLS schema, `CloudPlatformService`, `OtaUpdateService`, `LogSanitizer`.
- [docs/MCP_INTEGRATION.md](docs/MCP_INTEGRATION.md): Complete MCP tool reference & schematic verification protocol.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): High-level component topology & threading diagrams.
